answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 4551 Country: India Title: Is abortion permitted at an pregnancy of 3 months, due to financial constraints and no person to take care of child? Question: Is abortion permitted at an pregnancy of 3 months, due to financial constraints and no person to take care of child? Answer ID: 4551 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 426/426=M/1429) Abortion due to financial problem is unlawful. Yes, under medical compulsions it is allowable. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
